validation.earlier_test_expectation_errors: policy_tests.xml retains 66 passed and 3 failed: tests expected a committed key on Store ACK; corrected to the actual authoritative played/interrupted status and retained heard-event checks. No production behavior was changed to hide these test errors.

routing.enable: Explicit BoardBusinessConfig.visual_device_id; None keeps this disabled
routing.matching: Explicit visual/person-count requests including past questions precede generic conversation history, while original management/enrollment/identity/speaker priorities remain
routing.current: Only fresh accepted stable board-local health proof; explicitly persist a frozen camera_query source for the current query. No old timeline count used as current. Failure/unstable/expired proof produces an unknown answer, never assumed zero.
routing.history: Only configured device scope and observation topic visual; uses history_with_status and protected person-count claims, never infers counts/identity from free summary narrative
routing.time: Board-parsed explicit date or bounded recent-minute/hour range; ambiguous/unsupported time is rejected instead of silently widened or treated as current
routing.reply: Local Chinese template, at most 48 characters, original TTS and complete player ACK, no added LLM/vision model

memory.source_dependencies: SourcedBoardReply binds original same-device event/summary references through the unchanged same-scope Store assertions
memory.invalidation: Source forgetting/correction removes dependent played answers and summaries; invalidation before playback rejects a later full ACK
memory.original_scope: check_scope validates the live original job scope before device routing and in the local reply callback; no personal facts or grants become public
memory.recursive_recall_prevented: Observation history topic excludes normalized query/answer topic

verified: Actual jobs routes past person-count questions through local device policy with only TTS
Canonical query is a device event and never impersonates verbatim user speech
No private name, raw question, CID, identity or image enters device storage
Current stable, unstable, stale, zero and unavailable cases remain distinct
Same-frame current-source retry is idempotent; forgotten tombstone cannot restore itself
Event/summary forgetting and fact correction invalidate dependent played answers
Partial playback never enters heard recall; forgotten source rejects pending ACK
History reports no-match, limit, omitted boundary summaries and irreversible summary details within 48 characters
Compacted protected person-count claims are used without copying free narrative or identity
Original expired profile authorization cannot be skipped by selecting device scope
remaining: Parent-managed actual board query/current-health/physical receipt and full runtime acceptance. Previous RESULT.json documents the earlier collector-only snapshot; this file is the later query completion snapshot.
